_comment: Voice ids and delivery settings per language and kind, read by scripts/build-audio.js. One voice narrates everything in both languages: the voice dougdevitre/remam renders its prayer audio with (scripts/generate-prayer-audio.mjs there), so Stand and REMAM sound the same. A kind may still name its own voiceId and model to override the language's. Changing anything here changes every item's hash it applies to, so the next build re-renders what it touches. No secrets live here; the API key comes from ELEVENLABS_API_KEY. Traditional prayers start from the prayer settings and take stability, style and speed from their own entry in prayers.js when it has them.

en.voiceName: REMAM narration voice (the voice dougdevitre/remam renders its prayer audio with)

es.voiceName: REMAM narration voice (the voice dougdevitre/remam renders its prayer audio with)
